title: helianthemum pilosum var. strictum
intro: Helianthemum pilosum var. strictum, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a species of flowering plant in the family Cistaceae. It is a shrub-like perennial native to the mountainous regions of the Mediterranean, known for its fragrant flowers and medicinal properties. The Rock Rose is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds and skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic effects.
